messages:
anna_ml: Quick heads-up — onboarding run for proto32k-int4 on dedicated pool showed divergence vs fp16 baseline when we enable kv-compact-mode + bucketed prefill. Short repro attached below.
ben_platform: Can you paste the minimal repro steps and the exact flag set you used?
anna_ml: repro: `./serve --model proto32k-int4 --kv-mode compact --prefill-mode bucketed --prefill-waterline 16384 --quant-profile int4_pc_asym` then run a 24k token prompt (truncated below).
carla_infra: Did you checksum the KV after prefill? last time similar behavior was wrap-sentinel handling in the index.
dino_research: Also suspect RoPE slope mismatch after int4 scaling — quant scale table might be getting applied per-shard inconsistently. Quick check: compare pos-embedding multipliers between fp16 and int4 runtimes.
anna_ml: quant profile: int4 per-channel asymmetric, 8-entry scale table, `compress_metadata=true`. ran baseline fp16 on same rig (no compact) and results aligned until ~12k tokens, then proto-int4 starts hallucinating token shifts.
ben_platform: Try disabling kv-compact-mode and re-run with bucketed prefill to isolate compression. Also run `kv-checksum --level=2` and paste the first/last checks. ci-bot: build 18231: proto32k-int4 image pushed to staging. :white_check_mark:
anna_ml: pasted kv-checksum excerpt:
```
kv-checksum baseline: 0x5a3f9c12
kv-checksum proto32k-int4(compact): 0x7b2c4e9a
kv-checksum proto32k-int4(no-compact): 0x5a3f9c12
```
carla_infra: That looks like compacted path mutates index ordering — likely off-by-stride when applying bucket offsets. Run `rope-slope-check --compare fp16 int4 --window 16000` to see phase drift.
dino_research: Also add a short goldset eval (5 prompts with anchored answers) to confirm quality regression vs token drift. If phase drifts, try toggling `prefill-stride=1` (disable bucketing stride) as a quick test.
anna_ml: Will run rope-slope-check + goldset this afternoon and report. If confirmed, plan is: revert compacted prefill on canary and open a patch to fix bucket offset arithmetic.
ben_platform: Sounds good. Prioritize canary revert if prod canaries fail. :eyes: 
anna_ml: thanks — kicking off runs now, will post results (rope diffs + goldset BLEU-like scores) in this thread.
